Image 1 is the exact character identity and EAST camera reference. Image 2 gives higher-resolution face, costume and instrument details of this SAME girl, not the camera direction. Image 3 is the approved PRIMARY painted-style reference only; do not copy the UI, lettering or any other character.
Preserve her plum-purple long straight hair, lotus high bun with gold/pearl ornaments, violet eyes, tiny forehead jewel, ivory/lavender flowing sleeves with warm-gold edging, lavender trousers, ivory-gold ankle boots, green waist knot, purple/gold elongated seven-string celestial qin with crescent ornament and purple tassel. Rounded short-limbed Daoist chibi hand painting, bright clean restrained shading, no plastic 3D, no magenta outline.
She runs toward screen RIGHT, exact right-side profile EAST, face looking right. Camera fixed, orthographic game sprite, slightly above eye level as reference. Fixed world ground at 92% canvas height, root center x=50%; full body and ribbons inside canvas with clear margin. Keep head/body dimensions stable across the animation. A neutral head top would be about 12% canvas, stance sole about 92%. Do not auto-fit or enlarge her body to the canvas.
FRAME E01, right-foot landing: NEAR anatomical RIGHT leg reaches moderately forward to screen right, knee flexed, ball of foot just contacts y=92%; FAR LEFT leg trails toward screen left with heel lifted and knee starting to fold. Running forward lean about 10 degrees from ankles, not walking upright. This is contact just before compression. Both feet must be individually readable.
Both hands CARRY the same qin diagonally securely in front of chest: anatomical LEFT hand continues supporting the forward/high end; RIGHT hand wraps the near/lower body instead of plucking. Shoulders and bent elbows react to locomotion; qin tilts a little with torso while both exact grip points stay attached. No exaggerated alternate arm release, no switched hands, no new strap. Hair/ribbons trail left, no motion blur. Arms/instrument shift gently opposite forward right thigh through thorax counter-rotation. No ground, shadow, scenery, text, grid, border, duplicate character or extra limbs. Create actual joint pose, not translation/warping of existing pixels.
